plan.title: Donation Summary
plan.subtitle: An overview of donation activity for the year.

panels.title: Total Donations
panels.sql: SELECT sum(amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions WHERE Date >= strftime('%Y-01-01', 'now')

panels.title: Donations by City
panels.sql: SELECT City, sum(amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions WHERE Date >= strftime('%Y-01-01', 'now') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Monthly Donations
panels.sql: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', Date) AS month, sum(amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions WHERE Date >= strftime('%Y-01-01', 'now') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Top Donors
panels.sql: SELECT Donor, sum(amount) AS total FROM donor_transactions WHERE Date >= strftime('%Y-01-01', 'now') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

plan.narrative: This page provides a summary of donation activity for the current year.  {{p1.total}} represents the total amount donated.  Donations are distributed across various cities, with {{p2.total}} being the highest.  The monthly trend shows {{p3.total}} in each month. The top {{p4.limit}} donors are listed, contributing to the overall success.
